title: bench_repro reads and checks the benchmark briefs and frozen questions, and repro status shows no instance commit reached the real origin
goal: bench_repro.load_briefs(path=None) returns the rows of kb/public/_retrieval/repro_briefs.csv as dicts with the columns area, scope, sources, depth, coverage and leave_out; bench_repro.brief_problems names each row with an empty area, scope, sources, depth or coverage cell, a coverage other than present, partial or absent, or a duplicate area; repro questions exits 1 naming each brief area without 3 to 5 rows, a duplicate id, a row with no expect_re, expect_text or expect_paths, or a row whose question kbfacts.routed routes; repro status prints per instance the commits on its bare since the start commit and exits 1 when any of them is reachable from a fresh fetch of the real origin's main, and its output carries none of bl_check.NOOP_MARKERS; no new test id: the test_bench.py bundle gains a body that plants briefs, questions and an instance bare and runs brief_problems, repro questions and repro status on them.

run:
import importlib.util,subprocess,sys
sys.path.insert(0,'_tools')
if importlib.util.find_spec('bench_repro') is None: print('no bench_repro module yet'); sys.exit(1)
import bench_repro as b
bad=[{'area':'x','scope':'','sources':'s','depth':'d','coverage':'present','leave_out':''},{'area':'x','scope':'s','sources':'s','depth':'d','coverage':'maybe','leave_out':''}]
p=b.brief_problems(bad); print(p); sys.exit(0 if len(p)>=3 else 1)
